meta.title: Daily Coding – a coding challenge every day
meta.description: Solve a new coding challenge every day in the language of your choice and climb the ranking.
meta.ogImageAlt: The DAILY CODING landing page: the words "One challenge every day" in pixel lettering, two buttons below it and the top edge of the dashboard

hero.subline: Not a library of thousands of exercises where you never know where to start. One task a day: the one that counts for everyone today.
hero.screenshotAlt: The Daily Coding dashboard with rank, points, streak and today's challenge

newTask.detail: The same one for everybody. It follows from the calendar day, not from your profile.

test.detail: In the browser, in your language. As often as you like.

submit.detail: One attempt. Pass or fail, that settles the day.

streak.detail: A solved day extends it. A skipped one puts it back to zero.

routine.heading: DAYS TURN INTO SKILL
routine.intro: A single exercise is forgotten by tomorrow. This sticks around and shows you how far you have come.

levelUp.title: Level up
levelUp.detail: Points for every task you solve, levels for the points you collect. From beginner to legend, and every tier sits twice as far out as the one before.

compete.title: Measure up
compete.detail: Weekly and monthly standings by tasks solved. Points break the tie.

feed.title: Look around
feed.detail: Who solved today, who levelled up, who picked up a badge. Same task, plenty of people.

calendar.title: Look back
calendar.detail: A calendar of the days you solved. You can see at a glance where you kept it up.

codeDemo.claim: The same test cases that grade your submission later run in the browser first. As often as you like, in your language.

cta.heading: BE THERE TOMORROW
cta.body: Or start with today's. It is still running.
cta.artworkAlt: Pixel-art night scene: a desk with books, a steaming mug, an old CRT monitor whose green glow washes the wall, a keyboard and a switched-off lamp, and on the right a window with a full moon
